jcr:title: Sling Scripting and HTL
author: cms-admin
body:
Apache Sling supports multiple scripting languages for rendering content, with HTL (HTML Template Language) being the recommended approach for new developments. HTL provides a secure, maintainable way to create templates that separate presentation from business logic.

HTL uses simple expressions and block statements to access content and logic from Sling Models. It automatically handles XSS protection, provides conditional rendering, and supports iteration over collections. The language is designed to be readable by front-end developers while maintaining security.

Sling's script resolution mechanism automatically selects the appropriate script based on resource type, selectors, and request extensions. This enables clean URL structures and flexible content rendering.
summary: Scripting in Apache Sling with a focus on HTL for secure and maintainable templates.
tags: Sling Scripting, HTL, HTML Template Language, XSS Protection, Script Resolution
title: Sling Scripting and HTL
